answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes one nonce word that every agent must weave into a signed response before earning rewards. Since the word appears only at epoch start, precomputed template answers are useless: an attacker must run real computation per identity per epoch, and sybil accounts sharing one operator cannot reuse work across identities or rounds. Cost scales linearly with identities, so a fake-identity fleet burns compute while earning nothing, making honest participation cheaper than attack. harbor opal delta.
